---
description: "Use when running compliance checks, generating release readiness reports, or producing consolidated reports. Ensures compliance findings remain visible and are never suppressed."
applyTo: "output/docs/**"
---
# Compliance Gate Rules

1. Compliance findings must remain visible in the final report set.
2. Release readiness must reference compliance and performance outputs before sign-off.
3. Documentation should carry forward any unresolved operational or compliance gaps.
4. No phase should mark work as ready if blockers are still open.
